# Copilot Instructions

Project-wide guidance for GitHub Copilot in this workspace.

## Source of Truth

- `AGENTS.md` — canonical workspace guidance, toolchain, commands, conventions, and automation rules.
- `.hermes.md` — Hermes-specific overrides.
- `CLAUDE.md` — Claude-family guidance.
- `.cursorrules` — Cursor IDE agent rules.

## Dispatch

- Read `AGENTS.md` first.
- Use subproject `AGENTS.md` for `projects/*/`.
- For Hermes prompt/pipeline work, also see `.github/prompts/`.
